verdict.rationale: incident.io's postmortem AI docs say it can "Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI," which matches an AI-drafted postmortem built for human review. The product also auto-generates an incident timeline from key events, and its AI Suggestions draft follow-up actions from incident activity. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the AI draft covers contributing factors, detail on which sections the draft pulls from the incident record, and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
